articles.title: Liberia agrees to accept 1,200 third-country deportees from US within a year
articles.summary: Liberia agreed to accept 1,200 third-country deportees from the U.S. over the next year, with the first group of 20 expected to arrive on Thursday.

articles.title: Media executive overcomes Trump endorsement in race to succeed Byron Donalds in ‘circus-like primary’
articles.summary: Catalina Lauf, an appointee from the first Trump administration, lost to businessman Jim Schwartzel in a heated primary to succeed Rep. Byron Donalds.

articles.title: Irankunda says Hanson's monoculture comments upset team during World Cup
articles.summary: Socceroo Nestory Irankunda says his fellow players were upset by One Nation leader Pauline Hanson's comments during the World Cup about ending Australia's policy of multiculturalism.
